quote: Don't trust client-supplied role/privilege fields — role comes from the server-side session/token claims validated against the DB, never from a request body (`{"role": "admin"}` mass assignment, see rules/07)
Binding request bodies directly to ORM/domain models lets clients set fields you never exposed: `{"role":"admin"}`, `{"email_verified":true}`,
Fix structurally: **explicit per-endpoint DTOs/schemas** (input models with only the writable fields), then map allowed fields to the entity. Allowlist, never blocklist:
